response_texts: You are like a raging beast. This is why Ja'zel has high hopes for you.
There would be no point in tightening your reins otherwise, no? But as pleasing as it is to do so, this is not the path we want to walk.
Good, very good. Disciplining you is paying off, no? Ja'zel is pleased. Then let us repeat.
Wonderful. Resisting fate is what makes you who you are, no? But now is not the time for it yet.
Some things cannot be hidden. Here and now, this one shall reveal her name.
Once more, let us reveal the name of the hidden one. All lies shall be uncovered.
Under the glow of the White Star, you are reborn through violence, and with unbound hands you will echo forth.
Her name is...
Hey, what are you two doing in a huddle here? Come, let's have a drink!
Uncle Brandt, you know what?
What's wrong, Lalanoah? You're not okay... This is a party, cheer up!
I'll do my best! I'll become a respectable healer and get stronger and... eh, anyway...
Yes? I don't know about you, but this is what a true Nord would say!
You are a maggot now. No better than a louse. There is nothing else for you to do but die.
Come on, then. Let this one show you the depths of the den, down where Ysgramor and his sons once chased the hare.
Ja'zel will kill you. And so, Khajiit will show the world just what the cat's Love is all about.
There are marks of a violent assault... She must have been tortured right until they killed her. I feel so sorry for her...
Orlando, I almost forgot. There should be a gem on the staff... Do you know anything about this?
No, I don't. There were no gems on it when I got it.
Oh, I see. So they stole the gem? Well, I can't do anything about it now...
Lalanoah, I need to talk to the jarl, so take that staff and go straight home. No side trips, all right?
Yep, I understand. I'll wait for you at home, uncle Brandt.
Oh, wonderful, how wonderful! This is...
You are still alive? Unlucky...
This is the bottom of the world river, the undercurrent of all possibilities. Here in Dreamsleeve, the Silent Mother traces the glow of the White Star still.
This is the heaven for those with nowhere left to go. Lost souls slumber in deep reverence of Iana-Lor and become kindling for the flame of Magnus.
Eventually, that flame will dry up Nirn as it once did Lyg of old. And all shall be freed from the world.
We finally cleaned up here. It will be fine for now. Let's leave now...
What in... This isn't normal, where did they find so many corpses?
That was good, Lalanoah. Let's make it again when we get the chance.
Yep, I like apple pies. But next time I want to make sweetrolls.
Of course, little miss gluttony. All right, next time we'll make sweetrolls.
Yes! Promise, promise, pleeeease?
Yes, I promise.
Oh, right! I almost forgot something!
Ow, my head is starting to hurt. It doesn't feel right...
Lalanoah, let me. I want a try.
Okay, Grolly. But be careful. Your head will start to hurt.
All right, all right.
Oh, no... My head is clearing up. My tongue feels smoother...
You're speaking fluently, Grolly!
That's right. You're amazing, Lalanoah.
Well, you're also pretty amazing!
Oh! This feeling... as if something is rising within me...
Yes, let's make an apple pie. Let's do this.
Apple pie? I like apple pies. Let's make one.
Well then, let's go to the kitchen right away. I can't help it but I really want to cook something.
Yep. Apple pie, apple pie!
Watch your step. Apple pie won't run away.
O little louse. You still have your eyes, don't you? Ignorance is good.
It is foolish to give yourself over to the Owl. So turn back. It is only a single mistake.
Oh, Ms. Hamah. I haven't seen you in a while.
I am Lalanoah. Who are you?
I am Kalka. What can I do for you today, Ms. Hamah?
...I'm Lalanoah. A mushroom turned my friends all wrong. Can you help me?
This is the mischief of the Shivering Mushroom. It is a naughty one. Use this potion.
Thank you, Kalka.
No need to thank me, Ms. Hamah.
Umm, I said my name is Lalanoah...
Hey, Kalka? Can I come here again?
Of course. I will be waiting for you.
Um, to St. Bazura who sacrificed himself in order to defeat the monster of Falkreath two hundred years ago!
May we be blessed with best wishes for his repeated death and rebirth!
Bazura! Bazura! May we all be well tomorrow and in the next days!
Ozwald, Ozwald... You are finally here... So long... I've been waiting for you, for such a long time...
I remember at last... I had a sister... A child who smiles like the sun and loves white flowers... Or am I remembering it wrong?
...Why... why don't you say anything, Ozwald? Oh, I see... You still believe in Hinnom...
I will make you see the truth. Then we will go get my sister together... There is nothing you and I cannot do...
Zennrili an Zennji tas jaadi atha'a. Shabar aydithozay zaigu di sallidadna jaadi ranjith.
Adi vasa nirni jaadi lurma. Raj'kono viti shabar morna. An thzi kha'jay t'harithse!
There are Dwemer automatons in the city. But they seem different from what we usually find in Dwemer ruins, right?
They're probably from the time of the Resdayn Union. Their unique design is due to the Chimeri cultural influence at the time.
Resdayn Union... So, from the time around the First Council. What are these automatons capable of?
They are very strong and incredibly durable fighters. A pity they didn't produce more of them... but they were difficult to maintain.
They were used a lot during the War of the First Council. They were so popular that owning one became a sign of social status.
...Looks like you're having fun, Romion.
Really? I don't think so.
So what do you think of this mission, Romion?
Ashlanders rioting... I heard they were a fairly moderate bunch there. It's surprising...
What's the Eastmarch's response to the riot going to be?
Citizens of Ebonwall were slaughtered... Retaliation is certain. Volunteer militia is on its way there already.
Ebonwall will be a battlefield by the time we arrive so we'll need to decide where to land depending on the battle situation.
Ebonwall is roughly divided into the foothills and mountainous area... The witch is unlikely to be in the foothills where the volunteer army will attack first.
The Ashlanders will try to buy their time at the foothills and then barricade themselves in the mountains. There's a somewhat open area on the hillside. Drop us there.
The mission's success depends on how long the Nord army is stuck at the foothills. If you take too much time you may have to fight against the Nords, too.
We'll cross that bridge once we get there.
It's a perfect plan, but... I'm worried.
This is the mission you have been waiting for, yes? But it seems that you lost one member and then immediately gained another... How is it working out for you, hmm?
It might be better if we got some easy missions first... I don't want my new rookie to break.
That is an unreasonable request. Is Hinnom's motto not "the right person in the right place"? It is also Ja'zel's.
...So what is our mission? Say it quickly before I start regretting it.
Ashlanders rioted in the town called "Wulfharth's Ebonwall" to the east of Skyrim, near the border with Morrowind.
We already know that the leader of this riot was a Glenmoril witch, yes? Your mission is...
...kill the witch and take her Red Drop. I understand, yes.
This explains in more detail. The mission documents, yes? You should read them while you travel with the airship.
I understand. I'll give them to Romion.
That would be best, no? Fight well.
